author: Nelev
body:
## Summary

Builds on #4, which merged the `POST /messages` endpoint and the chunking/embedding pipeline. This carries the work that landed after that merge: persisting chunks into a vector store, and the UI metadata that was still create-next-app defaults.

## Chroma integration

Chunks are indexed into a persistent Chroma collection along with their text and metadata, so a query returns usable context rather than bare ids and distances — previously `add` received only `ids` and `embeddings`, and every result came back with `documents: None`.

Queries pass `query_embeddings` rather than `query_texts`. `query_texts` makes Chroma embed the question with its bundled 384-dim MiniLM; against a collection built from 1536-dim OpenRouter vectors that raises `InvalidArgumentError`, and had the dimensions happened to agree it would instead have silently compared two unrelated vector spaces and returned confidently ranked noise.

`PersistentClient` keeps the store across runs, so a re-run no longer pays to rebuild what the previous run discarded at exit. `upsert` replaces existing ids, where `add` keeps the stored copy and drops the new vector without warning — which matters because `chunk_id` is deterministic by design. The collection is created with `hnsw:space=cosine`; that is fixed at creation and silently ignored for a collection that already exists.

`chromadb` is declared in `pyproject.toml` — it was installed but absent from the manifest — and the generated store is gitignored.

## UI

Document metadata now carries the application's own title and description. The hardcoded `MESSAGES` array — sample copy about a Q3 churn report, unrelated to this domain and visible on first load — is emptied, so the chat shell renders in its real initial state until the API is wired up.

## Testing

- `ruff check .` clean across the API package; `main.py` imports
- `embeddings.py` executed top to bottom with `openai` stubbed and Chroma running for real: one API call carrying 21 string inputs, documents and metadata present on the query result
- Persistence checked by running twice in separate processes: collection count stays 21 rather than doubling, metric reads `cosine`, store survives process exit
- The `rag_pipeline/chroma/` ignore rule verified against a realistic store — both the top-level SQLite file and a nested index file are caught

**Not verified:** the live OpenRouter call. The sandbox blocked outbound requests carrying the record text, so the real vector dimension is unconfirmed, as is whether OpenRouter serves `/embeddings` at all — its compatibility surface has historically covered chat completions only. If it does not, `const.py` is the single place to repoint.

## Notes for review

- `chromadb` pulls a large dependency tree — the lockfile goes from 64 to 115 packages, most of it for the local ONNX model this project does not use, since it supplies its own vectors. `pgvector` is already a dependency and Postgres is already running, so consolidating on one store is worth considering before this becomes load-bearing.
- `rag_pipeline/embeddings.py` uses absolute imports (`from chunks import ...`), which resolve only when the file is run as a script. `import rag_pipeline.embeddings` fails, so nothing in the app can import it yet.
- `chore(data): set patient sex to male` is a one-word data edit that came from the working tree rather than from this line of work.
